newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Mill demand underpins basis.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Mill demand underpins basis.

text.p: Renewed mill demand for hard red winter wheat has strengthened some basis bids in the central U.S. Plains, grain dealers said Wednesday.
"Basis levels have picked up a little bit. Some of the mills have shown some more interest (in buying) lately," a south central Kansas grain dealer said.
But dealers reported movement of grain remained slack as open, dry weather conditions allowed fieldwork to progress in earnest through much of the area.
However, dealers said dry areas of eastern Colorado and western Kansas received rain overnight.
One merchandiser said at least 0.25 inch of rain fell overnight in Colby, Kan.
"It fell in eastern Colorado, western Kansas -- they sure needed it," a Kansas dealer said.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
(Note: K=KCBT May wheat futures. N=KCBT July. unq- unquoted, na - not applicable)
